drug_class: Selective If (funny channel) inhibitor; Bradycardic agent

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces ivabradine plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor heart rate closely and consult cardiologist for dosage adjustment

avoid_supplements.name: Grapeseed Extract (high dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases ivabradine levels and bradycardia risk

caution_supplements.name: Hawthorn
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive negative chronotropic effects may increase bradycardia risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive heart rate reduction; report dizziness or syncope

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids (high dose >3g/day)
caution_supplements.action: Monitor heart rate; maintain standard dosing <3g/day

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases ivabradine bioavailability and plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products; increases risk of bradycardia and adverse effects

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase ivabradine absorption and bioavailability variability
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain routine for predictable drug levels

monitoring_notes: Monitor resting heart rate target (typically 50-60 bpm); assess for dizziness, syncope, or excessive fatigue during therapy. CYP3A4 interactions are primary concern; counsel patients on CYP3A4 inhibitor/inducer avoidance.
